profiles.biography: Blair Williams is a percussion adjudicator, arranger, and instructor and a percussion arranger/instructor for the University of Nevada, Reno Wolf Pack Marching Band. He marched in the Sacramento Mandarins snare line (2000-2001, DCI Division II title 2001) and the Concord Blue Devils snare line (2002-2003, helping the corps to its 11th DCI World Championship and placing fourth in the individual snare competition), then served on the Mandarins percussion staff (2004-2012), including percussion caption head in 2009, and as co-caption head of the Pioneer drum corps in 2010. He holds a Master of Music in Music Education from the University of Nevada, Reno and adjudicates for DCI and competitive fall and winter circuits.

facts.fact: Blue Devils & Mandarins snare; Mandarins percussion caption head; UNR Wolf Pack percussion; DCI percussion judge

profiles.biography: Jeremy Tate is a visual adjudicator on the active Drum Corps International roster who works as a clinician and adjudicator nationwide for DCI, Winter Guard International, Bands of America, and various regional circuits. A native of Humboldt, Tennessee, he served as visual caption head for the Memphis Sound drum and bugle corps and on the visual staff of the Southwind and Madison Scouts. He is Music Advisor and Consultant for the Gibson County Special School District band programs and previously spent 15 years as Director of Bands at Gibson County High School in Dyer, Tennessee.

facts.fact: DCI visual judge; Memphis Sound visual caption head; Southwind/Madison Scouts visual staff; Tennessee band director

profiles.biography: Brad Huneycutt is a drill writer, music arranger, educational clinician, program coordinator, and adjudicator with over twenty years in music education, including service as a high school band director in Texas. He earned a Bachelor of Music from the University of Texas at Arlington and a Master of Music in Instrumental Conducting from Texas Christian University, and has taught at TCU, Prosper High School, William B. Travis High School, and Lake Highlands High School. A member of the DCI World Champion Cavaliers, he adjudicates for the Drum Corps International Summer Music Games as well as Music for All and Bands of America.

facts.fact: Drill writer/arranger; Cavaliers alum; UTA + TCU degrees; Texas band director; DCI/BOA music judge

profiles.biography: Edward 'Ed' Argenziano is a percussion adjudicator, arranger, composer, and clinician who holds a B.S. in Music Education from William Paterson University and an M.A. in Music Performance from Montclair State University, and was Director of Bands at Morris Knolls High School (Rockaway, NJ) from 1986 to 2014. He served as DCI Percussion Caption administrator (1997-1999) and DCA Percussion administrator (2001-2003), was percussion arranger/show designer for the 2004 Magic of Orlando and a 2005 consultant for the Colts, and designed for the New York Skyliners. He has judged music events for DCI, Drum Corps Japan, Bands of America, and WGI across the U.S., Canada, the Netherlands, and Japan, and is a published composer with Row-Loff Productions and a Ludwig/Musser artist.

facts.fact: DCI Percussion Caption administrator 1997-99; Morris Knolls HS Dir of Bands; Magic of Orlando designer; Row-Loff composer; DCI percussion judge

profiles.biography: Jackie Campbell is a color guard adjudicator who has been an adjudicator for the New York Federation of Contest Judges and Winter Guard International since 1991, specializing in movement and equipment. A performer with the Rochester Crusaders drum and bugle corps and the Santa Clara Vanguard, she coordinated the West Genesee High School color guard (1984-1999 and 2010-2013) and has served as a Color Guard judge at DCI World Championships (2023, 2024, and the 2025 All-Age Finals).

facts.fact: WGI/NY Federation judge since 1991; Rochester Crusaders & SCV alum; West Genesee HS guard coordinator; DCI Color Guard judge

profiles.biography: John 'JJ' Pipitone is a percussion adjudicator, composer, and educator who won the DCI multi-tenor solo competition in 1989 and the PAS multi-tenor competition in 1990. He marched nine years of drum corps with the Dutch Boy, Phantom Regiment, and Concord Blue Devils, taught the World Champion Phantom Regiment (1995-1996) and served as its battery caption head and arranger in 1997, and instructed the Glassmen (1998-1999) and Crossmen (2000-2001). Judging worldwide since 2003, he adjudicates for Bands of America, USBands, WGI, DCI, Drum Corps Japan, and indoor circuits. He holds degrees from Morehead State University and the University of North Texas, and is a retired band director and real-estate investor in the Dallas-Fort Worth area who consults for the Texas A&M Commerce Pride Marching Band.

facts.fact: 1989 DCI Multi-Tenor Champion; Phantom Regiment battery caption head; Glassmen/Crossmen instructor; DCI/WGI/BOA percussion judge; Morehead State + UNT
